info.title: Wallet API
info.description:
The public API of the wallet: five Spring Boot WebFlux services behind one gateway.

**Signing in takes two calls.** `POST /oauth/login` checks the password and sends a one-time code to the
account's phone; `POST /oauth2/token` exchanges the code for a Bearer token. Every wallet call needs
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

**Money calls are idempotent.** Top up, transfer and withdraw require an `Idempotency-Key` header: a retry
with the same key returns the first result instead of moving money twice.

**Every movement is a balanced journal** in a double-entry ledger; `GET /api/v1/wallets/{id}/reconcile`
compares a wallet's balance with its ledger.

post.description: Adds money to your own wallet, named by alias or ID. Posted to the double-entry ledger as a balanced journal; the response carries the new balance.

parameters.description: Unique per money call, at most 100 characters. Retrying with the same key returns the first result instead of moving money twice; reusing a key with a different body is refused (409).

BalanceChangeRequest.description: Take money out of your own wallet. Users may only SUBTRACT; money comes in through top up.

amount.description: Amount; must be greater than zero.

operation.description: SUBTRACT for a withdrawal. ADD is refused for users (use top up).

message.description: Only present when the caller has no wallet.

walletId.description: Wallet ID; absent when the caller has no wallet.

GatewayErrorResponse.description: Rejected by the API gateway before reaching the service: no token, or a token that is invalid or expired.

LoginRequest.description: E-mail and password of an existing account.

MoneyMovementResponse.description: A completed money movement, posted to the double-entry ledger.

balanceAfter.description: Your wallet's balance after the movement.

journalRef.description: Reference of the balanced ledger journal that records it (the transaction ID).

status.description: Always COMPLETED; a movement that does not complete returns an error instead.

OAuthErrorResponse.description: A failed OAuth2 token request, in the OAuth2 error format.

ReconcileResponse.description: The wallet's cached balance compared with the balance derived from its ledger entries.

RegisterRequest.description: A new account. Creates the login and a ZAR wallet in one call.

email.description: E-mail address; used to sign in.

fullName.description: The person's full name. The wallet alias is derived from it.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number in international format; one-time sign-in codes go here.

SendOtpRequest.description: The account to send a code to, by e-mail or phone number, and its password.

email.description: The account's e-mail address. Send this or phoneNumber.

phoneNumber.description: The account's phone number in international format. Used when email is absent.

TokenRequest.description: OAuth2 token request with the OTP grant: the one-time code sent after a successful sign-in.

otp_code.description: The 6-digit code that was sent to the account's phone.

phone_number.description: The phone number used to sign in. Used when username is absent.

username.description: The e-mail address used to sign in. Send this or phone_number.

TokenResponse.description: An access token for the wallet API.

access_token.description: JWT to send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every wallet call.

TopUpRequest.description: Add money to your own wallet, named by alias or ID.

amount.description: Amount to add; must be greater than zero.

walletAlias.description: Your wallet's alias. Send this or walletId.

walletId.description: Your wallet's ID. Used when walletAlias is absent.

TransactionRecord.description: One entry in a wallet's transaction history.

recipientWalletId.description: Wallet the money reached, if any.

senderWalletId.description: Wallet the money left, if any.

userEmail.description: E-mail of the user who made it.

userPhone.description: Phone of the user who made it.

TransferRequest.description: Send money from your own wallet to another wallet, both named by alias.

amount.description: Amount to send; must be greater than zero and covered by your balance.

fromWalletAlias.description: Your wallet's alias; it must be yours.

active.description: False once the wallet is closed.

merchantId.description: Merchant the wallet belongs to, if any.

version.description: Optimistic-lock version; increases with every change.

walletAlias.description: Public alias other users pay to.
